cvars.name: sg.GlobalIlluminationQuality
cvars.description: Scalability group selecting the global illumination quality level (0 Low, 1 Medium, 2 High, 3 Epic, 4 Cinematic).
cvars.impact: Selects the GlobalIlluminationQuality scalability level; cost per level: not documented.
warnings: Setting an sg.* variable re-applies the CVars its scalability group assigns to that level and can overwrite individual CVars set earlier.

cvars.name: sg.ShadowQuality
cvars.description: Scalability group selecting the shadow quality level (0 Low, 1 Medium, 2 High, 3 Epic, 4 Cinematic).
cvars.impact: Selects the ShadowQuality scalability level; cost per level: not documented.
warnings: Setting an sg.* variable re-applies the CVars its scalability group assigns to that level and can overwrite individual CVars set earlier.
